The wall initially had 3 courses of bricks, so it had 3*400 = 1200 bricks.
They added 2 more courses, so the wall now has 3+2 = 5 courses.
The total number of bricks in the wall is 5*400 = 2000 bricks.
They took out half of the bricks in the last course, which is 400/2 = 200 bricks.
So the total number of bricks in the wall is 2000-200 = 1800 bricks.

The sum of the ages of the three boys is 29, so x + x + 11 = 29.
Combining like terms, we get 2x + 11 = 29.
Subtracting 11 from both sides, we get 2x = 18.
Dividing both sides by 2, we get x = 9.
Therefore, the other two boys are 9 years old.
